comparison.objective: Hand-pump a chamber into a target pressure band and return the pump; candidate removes HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Barrel counterholding, repeated reciprocation, and gauge-guided stopping versus precision alignment, single-event impact regulation, and fragment collection.
comparison.success_condition: 54–66 kPa without exceeding 80 kPa, pump on mat, and two-second released hold versus four fractures, containment, retained inserts, and no damage.
comparison.reason: Closed-loop pressure generation and stopping do not overlap meaningfully with tang fracture.
